message.content:
This magazine cover features the title "TEMPO" in large, white, serif capital letters against a teal, geometric patterned background. Two human silhouettes face each other: a man on the left in a suit and tie holding a briefcase, and a woman on the right in a long dress and heels. Superimposed over their torsos is a large yellow circle containing a stylized blue "M." Inside the "M," two hands meet in a handshake.

At the top, white and yellow text reads "PERANG BISNIS GO-PAY VERSUS OVO" and "NASIB HAK ASASI MANUSIA DI ERA JOKOWI." Below the silhouettes, large yellow capital letters state "LENGGAK-LENGGOK MEIKARTA." Smaller white text below this reads: "Bupati Neneng Hasanah tertangkap tangan menerima suap perizinan kota mandiri di Cikarang, Bekasi. Benarkah rencana suap melibatkan pemilik Lippo Group, James Riady?"

A white barcode box in the bottom-left corner contains numbers "00035," "9 770126 427302," "22-28 OKTOBER 2018," "RP 45.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126-4273." The cover has a red vertical border on the left side.
